# Box

A general-purpose container whose padding, surface, radius and border all come from tokens. Use it when you
need an area with a background that is not a full panel.

**Category**: Primitives · **Common uses**: Local background blocks, scrollable areas, padding around a group of content

## Import

```ts
import { Box } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

A block with a background, rounded corners and padding.

```tsx
export function Basic() {
  return (
    <Box surface="sunken" radius="md" padding={4}>
      <Text tone="secondary">A sunken background suits notes and secondary information</Text>
    </Box>
  )
}
```

## Variants

### Surfaces and borders

```tsx
export function Surfaces() {
  return (
    <Box surface="canvas" padding={4}>
      <Box surface="surface" border radius="lg" padding={4}>
        <Text>Panel surface with a hairline border</Text>
      </Box>
    </Box>
  )
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `padding` | `0 \| 1 \| 2 \| 3 \| 4 \| 5 \| 6 \| 7 \| 8` | Padding on all sides, as a spacing step. | — | No |
| `paddingX` | `0 \| 1 \| 2 \| 3 \| 4 \| 5 \| 6 \| 7 \| 8` | Horizontal padding, as a spacing step (overrides the left and right of `padding`). | — | No |
| `paddingY` | `0 \| 1 \| 2 \| 3 \| 4 \| 5 \| 6 \| 7 \| 8` | Vertical padding, as a spacing step (overrides the top and bottom of `padding`). | — | No |
| `surface` | `'none' \| 'canvas' \| 'surface' \| 'sunken' \| 'elevated'` | Background surface: `canvas`, `surface` (panel), `sunken` (input backgrounds, table headers) or `elevated` (overlays). | `'none'` | No |
| `radius` | `'none' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl' \| 'full'` | Corner radius step. | `'none'` | No |
| `border` | `boolean` | Shows a hairline border. Hierarchy comes from backgrounds: separate blocks with `surface`, and use a border only where an outline is really needed, such as drop zones and placeholders. | — | No |
| `grow` | `boolean` | Takes up the remaining space in a parent Stack or Inline. | — | No |
| `scroll` | `boolean` | Scrolls inside this container when the content overflows. | — | No |
| `as` | `'div' \| 'section' \| 'header' \| 'footer' \| 'nav' \| 'aside' \| 'main' \| 'ul' \| 'ol' \| 'li'` | HTML element to render. | `'div'` | No |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | Content. | — | No |

Also accepts `testId` (rendered as `data-testid`), `aria-label`, `role` and `id`, like all primitives.

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.
